desc:
🤖 Welcome to Steal and Build [MECH]!

🌸 NEW: SHRINE ROAD! Zone 12 is open. Climb the shrine steps and steal crates from the giant Ōmukade!

🦊 NEW: NINE TAILS VALKYRIE! A robot fox mech with 9 tails, an Odachi and a long rifle

🍀 x2 LUCK WEEKENDS! Every Fri 12PM to Mon 12PM ET: double pet luck and Size Up Coins for everyone

🦃 Harvest Hunt + Scarecrow boss still running until Dec 1!

How to Play:
📦 Steal crates from the zones, guarded by giant bosses
🏃 RUN! Carry them home before the boss catches you
🔧 Open crates in your mech bay for mech parts
🦾 Build mechs to earn energy
⚡ Upgrade your charge rig to gain Haul Speed
⚗️ Fuse 3 alike parts or crates for a bigger size
🔥 Fight raids and climb the 7-floor Boss Tower for crates and pets

🎁 Join the group and step on the Free Gift pad for free Haul Speed

🎮 Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet
